In a post on X, Schiff noted that Bitcoin has plunged nearly 33% since Thanksgiving 2025, dropping from roughly $91,000 to around $61,000 as of this writing.

“Back when Bitcoin was still in a long-term bull market, HODLers would brag to their friends and family about their unrealized Bitcoin gains since the prior year’s Thanksgiving,” Schiff mocked BTC backers. “But with a 33% YoY loss, it may be a sore subject this year.”
